data_sources.notes: growth_habit='upright' inferred by Ollama (Trefle growth_habit is bare 'Forb/herb' - ambiguous between upright/rosette/spreading, deferred to Ollama); reasoning: Holy Basil (Tulsi) typically grows as an upright bush with a clump of stems and leaves.

life_cycle='annual' inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Holy Basil is typically grown as an annual in temperate climates like Belgium because it does not tolerate frost and is sensitive to cold temperatures.

is_edible corrected from false to true (GitHub issue #165): edible_parts=['leaves'] was already populated, a direct contradiction with is_edible=false, and no is_toxic flag or toxicity_notes explained the discrepancy - a full-dataset audit found this affecting 120 plants (grown from an earlier 25-plant spot-check once backlog #133's edible_parts backfill widened coverage), all of them unambiguous real food/herb/fruit crops.
